_comment: Copy to .t3/local/workers.json (gitignored). The driver re-reads it before EVERY delegate_task, so editing it between waves switches provider/model without restarting the driver. providerInstanceId and model must exist in orchestrator_capabilities and be able to run child tasks (canRunChildTask). options are the per-model options from orchestrator_capabilities (e.g. effort for Claude, variant for OpenCode).
_effort_levels: claudeAgent effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultrathink. opencode variant: low | medium | high | xhigh | max.
_note: These preset names point at providers available at time of writing. Re-check with orchestrator_capabilities on your machine before trusting them; add a preset for any new provider the same way. Claude models run through claudeAgent (your Claude subscription), not through OpenCode. Keep implementer and reviewer on different vendors when you can, so the reviewer does not share the implementer's blind spots.
